en.headline: Happiness index slips to 5.87, below pass mark for fourth year
en.dek: A Wofoo survey of 1,039 adults put the city at 5.87 out of 10, with Generation Y the least happy age group and more than 40 per cent reporting depressive symptoms.
body: Hong Kong's happiness index fell to 5.87 out of 10 this year, staying below a passing mark of six for a fourth consecutive year, according to a survey released on Tuesday by HK.WeCare, an initiative of Wofoo Social Enterprises.

The poll of 1,039 adults found the score down from 5.95 last year, though the organisers said the overall trend since 2024 remained upward and the latest figure was above the 2024 low. More than 40 per cent of respondents reported moderate to severe depressive symptoms.

People aged 30 to 45, described in the survey as Generation Y, were the least happy age group. The South China Morning Post reported that the organisers linked that result largely to dissatisfaction with economic and housing conditions.
Respondents also gave moderate scores for community belonging and trust, at 3.13 and 2.81 out of five. The survey team said both were directly linked to happiness.

zh.headline: 本港開心指數降至5.87 連續第四年未達合格線
zh.dek: 和富社會企業「香港開心D」訪問1039名成人，指數由去年5.95跌至5.87；約30至45歲組別最低，逾四成受訪者呈中度至嚴重抑鬱症狀。
body: 和富社會企業旗下「香港開心D」周二公布2026年香港開心指數，1039名成人的整體得分為10分滿分中的5.87分，較去年的5.95分下跌，並連續第四年低於6分合格線。
主辦方表示，指數自2024年以來整體仍呈回升，今年分數高於2024年的低位。調查發現，超過四成受訪者呈中度至嚴重抑鬱症狀。
約30至45歲、調查所稱的Y世代，是各年齡組別中最不開心的一群。據《南華早報》報道，主辦方認為這主要與對經濟及住屋狀況不滿有關。
受訪者對社區歸屬感及信任的評分分別為5分中的3.13分及2.81分。研究團隊稱，兩者都與開心程度直接相關。
